    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ArrayAdapter<C>
    Adapts array values.
    BasicJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter.basic()
    BeanModel
    The properties of a business object type, as JSON-B discovers them, shared by the JSON-B provider and the IU binding paths.
    BeanModel.Discovery
    How a model discovers properties.
    BeanModel.Visibility
    Decides which fields and methods of a class are properties.
    BinaryJsonAdapter
    Converts byte[] by a binary data strategy, named as JSON-B names them.
    BindingMetadata
    Binding annotations on a business object type and its members, as JSON-B defines them, read without referring to the JSON-B API.
    BindingMetadata.Format
    A date or number format a member, type, or package declares.
    BindingMetadata.TypeInfo
    The type information a type declares for polymorphic conversion: the key a JSON object names its subtype by, and each subtype's alias.
    BooleanJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Boolean, reading only JSON true and false
    CalendarJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Calendar; always reads a GregorianCalendar, so also adapts that type.
    CharacterJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Character, as a JSON string of exactly one character
    CollectionAdapter<E,C>
    Adapts Collection values.
    ContinuationReader
    Reads the rest of an object from the text it was parsed from, as a JSON object of its own: an opening brace, then the text from where the rest begins.
    ConversionScope
    Tracks the conversions of the JSON-B call in progress on each thread, for a conversion not bound to conversions of its own, such as an IuJsonProperties created without them.
    DateJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Date
    EnumerationAdapter<E>
    Adapts Enumeration values.
    EnumJsonAdapter<E>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Enum types.
    FormatAdapters
    Date and number conversions by format, shared by the JSON-B provider and the IU binding paths: a date pattern, milliseconds since the epoch, or strict I-JSON for dates, and a decimal pattern for numbers, as JSON-B defines them.
    Formats
    Holds the naming for each IU property name format.
    HttpException
    Thrown by IuHttp when an HTTP request cannot be completed successfully.
    HttpResponseHandler<T>
    Functional interface for converting a validated HTTP response.
    HttpResponseValidator
    Validates HTTP response status code and headers.
    ItemScope
    Tracks the item a collection, array, or map conversion is working on, so a failure can name it.
    IterableAdapter<E>
    Adapts Collection values.
    IteratorAdapter<E>
    Adapts Stream values.
    IuDeserializationContext
    One deserialization call: the options snapshot and property path from IuJsonbContext, plus the JsonbDeserializer invocations in progress for re-entry checks.
    IuHttp
    Provides common base-level whitelisting, logging, and exception handling utilities for HttpRequest and HttpResponse.
    IuHttpClientEvent
    Observable HTTP client event.
    IuJson
    JSON-P processing utilities.
    IuJsonAdapter<T>
    Adapts JSON values to equivalent Java types.
    IuJsonArrayAdapter<T,E>
    A conversion for a type whose values convert to and from a JSON array: arrays, including primitive arrays, and the iterable, collection, iterator, enumeration, and stream types IuJsonAdapter.of(Type) supports.
    IuJsonb
    Implements Jsonb over the IuJsonAdapter conversions, streaming through IuJsonAdapter.read(JsonParser) and IuJsonAdapter.write(Object, JsonGenerator).
    IuJsonb.AdapterReference
    A configured JsonbAdapter and the types it converts between.
    IuJsonbAdapter<T>
    Converts a business object type using its IuJsonbModel, as part of the call in progress: its options snapshot names the properties, its path locates a failure, and its cycle check rejects a recursive reference.
    IuJsonbBinaryAdapter
    Converts byte[] by the binary data strategy of the call in progress: JsonbConfig.BINARY_DATA_STRATEGY, or the IuJsonSerializationOptions.getBinaryDataStrategy() of a IuJsonAdapter.SERIALIZATION_OPTIONS snapshot; always BinaryDataStrategy.BASE_64_URL with JsonbConfig.STRICT_IJSON.
    IuJsonbBoundedParser
    The view of a parser a JsonbDeserializer reads through, limited to the value it deserializes.
    IuJsonbBuilder
    Builds IuJsonb instances; uses IuJson.PROVIDER unless another JSON-P provider is supplied.
    IuJsonbContext
    State shared by one serialization or deserialization call: a single options snapshot, and the property path to the value being converted.
    IuJsonbEnumAdapter<E>
    Converts an enum type as text, or as an object when IuJsonSerializationOptions.isEnumAsObject().
    IuJsonbGenerator
    Builds the JsonValue described by JsonGenerator calls, so a JsonbSerializer can run in a tree conversion.
    IuJsonbModel
    The properties of a business object type, as the provider converts them: a BeanModel discovered with the provider's visibility and order strategies, and each property's configured conversions.
    IuJsonbModel.Creator
    Creates a business object from values read from JSON, with its parameters' configured conversions.
    IuJsonbModel.Property
    One property, with its configured conversions.
    IuJsonbNaming
    How a call names properties in JSON: by an IU property name format, which a IuJsonAdapter.SERIALIZATION_OPTIONS supplier may change from call to call, or by a JSON-B PropertyNamingStrategy fixed for the provider.
    IuJsonbObjectAdapter
    Built-in conversion for Object and other broad declared types.
    IuJsonbParser
    Reports a JsonValue as JsonParser events, so a JsonbDeserializer can run in a tree conversion.
    IuJsonbProvider
    Provides IuJsonb through JsonbProvider service lookup.
    IuJsonBuilder<B>
    Functional base class for implementing JSON-based builder pattern behavior components.
    IuJsonbValueAdapter<T>
    Converts one Java type according to IuJsonb configuration.
    IuJsonProperties
    Indexes the properties of one JSON object, converting each to Java only when it's read.
    IuJsonProperties.Builder
    Builds an index from Java values.
    IuJsonPropertyNameFormat
    Enumerates property name formats for JSON conversion.
    IuJsonSerializationOptions
    Provides runtime tuning parameters for converting a JavaBeans business object, or an enum value, to JSON.
    IuSerializationContext
    One serialization call: the options snapshot and property path from IuJsonbContext, plus the values in progress for re-entry and cycle checks.
    IuVault
    Provides access to a HashiCorp Vault K/V secrets engine.
    IuVaultKeyedValue<T>
    Encapsulates a single keyed value from HashiCorp Vault.
    IuVaultMetadata
    Represents metadata related to a Vault K/V engine.
    IuVaultSecret
    Represents a HashiCorp Vault K/V secret.
    JsonAdapters
    Provides standard IuJsonAdapter instances.
    JsonArrayAdapter<T,E>
    Adapts to/from JsonArray values.
    JsonbMetadata
    Reads JSON-B annotations; the only class the IU binding paths reach that refers to the JSON-B API, loaded only when the API is present.
    JsonbPresence
    Determines, once, whether the JSON-B API is present, and so which BindingMetadata applies.
    JsonDeserializer
    Converts from JSON to a JavaBeans business object.
    JsonObjectAdapter<T,K,V>
    Adapts to/from JsonObject values.
    JsonProxy
    Thin invocation handler for wrapping JSON objects in a Java interface.
    JsonProxy.Declared
    Gets the conversion a getter declares.
    JsonSerializer
    Converts from a JavaBeans business object to JSON.
    JsonValueAdapter<T>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for a JSON-P value type, such as JsonObject, which converts as itself.
    NumberAdapter<N>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Number
    OptionalJsonAdapter<T>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Date
    OptionalNumberAdapter<O,N>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for OptionalInt, OptionalLong, and OptionalDouble; empty converts as JSON null.
    OptionsSwitch
    Converts by one of two conversions, as the options in effect for each conversion say.
    ParsingJsonAdapter<T>
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for types that provide a mechanism for parsing the value returned by Object.toString()
    ParsingJsonAdapter.Singletons
    Holds one instance per type, created on first use from the functions that use supplies; held by the class itself, so it doesn't keep the class from unloading.
    PrimitiveArrayAdapter
    Adapts arrays of a primitive component type, such as int[], whose items box to and from their wrapper type.
    PropertiesJsonAdapter
    Built-in conversion for IuJsonProperties: written as the object it indexes, and read as an index of the object, whose values convert when read.
    PropertyNaming
    Names Java properties in JSON, and matches JSON names when reading.
    RemoteInvocationDetail
    Remote invocation stack trace element details.
    RemoteInvocationException
    RuntimeException backed by RemoteInvocationFailure
    RemoteInvocationFailure
    Represents Throwable stack trace details for passing via remote call
    RemoteInvocationHandler
    Base class for client-side invocation of a Java interface by HTTP POST.
    RemoteInvocationStackTraceElementDetail
    Provides remote invocation failure details fro a StackTraceElement
    RuntimeTypeAdapter
    Converts a value of a broad declared type, such as Object, by its runtime type.
    ScopedParser
    A parser scoped to one value by the conversion that controls it, which a reader holding the value can prepare for before that conversion moves on.
    StreamAdapter<E>
    Adapts Stream values.
    TextForm<T>
    Converts values of a type that JSON represents as a number or boolean to and from text, for use as a JSON object key.
    TextJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for CharSequence, reading only JSON strings
    ThrowableRemoteInvocationFailure
    RemoteInvocationFailure implementation backed by Throwable
    TimeZoneJsonAdapter
    Implements IuJsonAdapter for Date
    Vault
    Provides access to secrets stored in HashiCorp Vault.
    VaultKeyedValue<T>
    Basic IuVaultKeyedValue implementation.
    VaultSecret
    Implements IuVaultSecret.
